title: ChatGPT Just Revealed Its Two-Step Playbook for AI Visibility. The more you create research-driven content that answers specific questions from Reddit and Quora, instead of promotional pitches, the faster you'll earn ChatGPT's trust and recommendations. The sooner you build authority distribution across multiple platforms (not just your website), the more AI will cross-reference and validate you as a credible source. The bottom line? If you're not creating definitive guides and spreading your expertise across multiple trusted sites, you're invisible to the AI that's answering your customers' questions. #AIVisibility #ResearchDrivenSEO #AuthorityDistribution
